gauge_and_reversal_theorem.antiunitary: Theta f=conjugate(f after R) is involutive and Theta*U_T*Theta=U_T^(-1)
gauge_and_reversal_theorem.normal_form: the gauge coordinate advances j by one, preserves q off the wrap, and sends q to eta*q at the wrap
gauge_and_reversal_theorem.reversor: reflect j to -j in each eta=+1 cycle, or t to -t in the eta=-1 unfolded cycle, then pull back through the gauge
gauge_and_reversal_theorem.unfolding: for eta=-1, psi(j,q)=j when q=+1 and N+j when q=-1 conjugates T to t->t+1 on Z/(2N)Z

progress_and_boundary.progress: reduces every marker configuration at every N to the parity invariant eta and proves the complete cycle, fixed-count, zeta, determinant, spectrum, gauge, and reversal laws
progress_and_boundary.route_a_obstruction: the cycles are finite and exactly reducible, with no intrinsic prime semantics, target divisor comparison, or target global analytic comparison
progress_and_boundary.sentinel_boundary: the exhaustive N<=10 enumeration is a regression sentinel only; the all-N and all-marker statement rests on the N-step and gauge proofs

source_lock.allowed_data: the frozen marker word and source-derived sign product eta
source_lock.arithmetic_origin: none; N and the arbitrary binary marker word are kinetic source inputs with no intrinsic prime semantics
source_lock.clock: one site advance with the marker at the departed site
source_lock.cutoff: all-parameter theorem; class ledger N<=24 and exhaustive marker enumeration N<=10
source_lock.determinant_convention: finite Artin--Mazur zeta and same-clock Koopman determinant det(I-zU_T)
source_lock.family: every N>=1 and every marker configuration epsilon in {+1,-1}^N
source_lock.forbidden_data: target zero or prime tables, arithmetic local data, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, Hilbert--Polya operators, and Route-B inputs
source_lock.normalization: labelled states first, then least periods and geometric cycles
source_lock.object: Kac ring T(j,s)=(j+1,epsilon_j*s) on Z/NZ times {+1,-1}
source_lock.precision: exact signs, permutations, integers, and symbolic polynomials

zeta_and_koopman_theorem.cycle_count: c=2N/L, hence c=2 for eta=+1 and c=1 for eta=-1
zeta_and_koopman_theorem.koopman: on l2 of the 2N states, U_T is the same-clock permutation unitary and det(I-zU_T)=(1-z^L)^c=zeta_T(z)^(-1)
zeta_and_koopman_theorem.root_spectrum: the eigenvalues are all L-th roots of unity, each with multiplicity c
zeta_and_koopman_theorem.self_adjoint_boundary: U_T is self-adjoint exactly when L<=2; this is a finite kinetic toy model, not a Hilbert--Polya construction
